title: Abelian transpose of the ordinary scalar coefficient-unit comparison
statement: In the setting of [lem-sp-tower-restricted-scalar-adjunction], let chi be any section-identity comparison of its specified forgetful direct-image functors; no adjunction a is assumed. Let theta0 be normalized CoefficientPullback data [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal]. Let eY:EY(RY)->AY and eX:EX(RX)->AX have ordinary scalar adjuncts equal to scalarGenerator [def-sp-tower-class-coefficients]. The source composite scalar/geometric adjunct of g.pull(eY) followed by theta0.hom, after applying UY and chi_AX, equals the abelian adjunct of d.forgetIso_RY followed by UX of the target scalar adjunct of EX(d.unitIso.hom) followed by eX. This is an equality of abelian tower maps and asserts no scalar-association isomorphism.

proof.text: On constant integer generators both maps are the same quotient map: use theta0.normalization, d.unit_normalization and integerPull. Scalars in the constant residue-ring sheaf locally lift to integer sections; linearity and separatedness extend the equality to all sections. The recorded Forget morphism equations and joint faithfulness of ordinary tower evaluation give the stated whole-tower equality.

theorem scalarUnit_abelianTranspose
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E) (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    (cY : Chern l E Y) (cX : Chern l E X)
    (d : IntegralCoefficientPullback l E f cY cX)
    (χ : (g.push ⋙ SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (coefficientSystemMap l E Y)) ⋙ cY.reduction.forget.F ≅
      (SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (coefficientSystemMap l E X) ⋙ cX.reduction.forget.F) ⋙ abPush f)
    (hχ : ∀ (N : Systems X (Arings l E X)) (n : ℕ) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : (((cY.reduction.forget.F.obj
        ((SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (coefficientSystemMap l E Y)).obj (g.push.obj N))).obj (op n)).obj.obj U)),
      HEq ((((χ.hom.app N).app (op n)).hom.app U) x) x)
    (θ₀ : CoefficientPullback l E b f g)
    (eY : cY.scalar.model.E.obj (coefficient Y (Rrings l Y)) ⟶
      coefficient Y (Arings l E Y))
    (eX : cX.scalar.model.E.obj (coefficient X (Rrings l X)) ⟶
      coefficient X (Arings l E X))
    (heY : (cY.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv _ _) eY = scalarGenerator l E Y)
    (heX : (cX.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv _ _) eX = scalarGenerator l E X) :
    cY.reduction.forget.F.map
        (((cY.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.comp g.ordinaryAdjunction).homEquiv _ _)
          (g.pull.map eY ≫ θ₀.iso.hom)) ≫
        χ.hom.app (coefficient X (Arings l E X)) =
      ((abAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _)
        (d.forgetIso.hom.app (coefficient Y (Rrings l Y)) ≫
          cX.reduction.forget.F.map
            ((cX.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv _ _)
              (cX.scalar.model.E.map d.unitIso.hom ≫ eX)))
